name: silent-hill-halo-of-flesh
description: Prototype fan-made non commercial de combat 2D consacré aux manifestations de Silent Hill, avec 230 profils, 4 600 mouvements lore-first et un directeur de 123 arènes : 14 terrains, 15 bascules Otherworld, 22 chorégraphies visuelles d’événements, IA défensive et 29 dangers télégraphiés.

scripts.verify: node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify-only
scripts.build: node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify-only && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify
scripts.qa:browser: node scripts/http-qa-v090.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-sprites.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-art-v092.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-clips-v093.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-recovery-v094.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-boundaries-v095.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-presentations.mjs
